messages.subject: App not displaying datatable table consistently
parts:
When you load my app (https://asashinyapps.shinyapps.io/shootingshinyapp/) and go to the xGoals navbar item, and down to team, you see two datatable tables. Whenever I first load the app on shinyapps.io, the first data table on that is forced to show 10 rows. It is not forced to show 10 rows on my local version, and if you click a few controls in the sidebar, the issue goes away.

In other words, this does not seem to be a silly coding issue. shinyapps.io for whatever reason initially displays an errant datatable, and then corrects it when controls are changed.

Any ideas on why this might be?
